title: One rule for which project an issue id belongs to
what_shipped: bd import now decides whether an issue id belongs to the database the same way bd create does: the id starts with the configured prefix and a hyphen. The guessing heuristic that split ids at their last hyphen no longer decides membership in the importer, the rename check, --rename-on-import, or bd rename-prefix --repair, so an export holding ids like ben-w31-p0a loads back instead of refusing the whole file. The post-merge hook bd installs now prints the import error instead of discarding it. The installed bd was rebuilt from the final tree, and a shutdown flush race that could drop the last mutation was fixed along the way.

key_decisions.decision: Reverted the accepted F2 multi-repo clause after review v2 showed it aborted whole import batches
key_decisions.why: handleRename's CreateIssue validates the configured prefix in every mode, so the configured-prefix test is the only predicate that leads to a create that can succeed

key_decisions.why: The review cap is 3; the fixes were a comment move, a test-env filter and one stderr line, verified by the manager with tests, gofmt and diff
